subject: Decision criteria follow-up: latency / cost / deployment / next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finova.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@finova.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Decision criteria follow-up: latency / cost / deployment / next steps

Hi Alex / Priya

Thanks again for taking the time today. Wanted to capture the key items we discussed and confirm a few decision criteria so we can tailor the next proposal and architecture. Summary below; please correct anything I got wrong.

Key takeaways from today's call:
- Primary use case: real-time customer support triage + automated summary generation for high-volume chat (peak bursts up to 150 reqs/sec).
- Performance target: P99 generation latency <= 300ms for 512-token prompts; P95 <= 150ms.
- Cost sensitivity: targeting <= 0.6 USD per 1k tokens (normalized unit) for inference if possible; open to tradeoffs if SLA/latency needs require dedicated capacity.
- Deployment preference: Finova is leaning toward Dedicated (reserved GPU capacity) for predictable throughput, with Private (VPC) as a fallback for compliance if required by procurement/security.
- Procurement & security: Priya will lead procurement; security has a standard questionnaire and wants SOC 2 + encryption-at-rest + audit logs.

Open clarifying questions (can you confirm):
1) Economic buyer: is the procurement owner (Priya) the final sign-off or is there a separate finance approver?
2) Latency SLAs: are the P99/P95 targets above strictly required or aspirational?
3) Deployment constraints: any nonnegotiable networking/firewall rules for Private deployment (e.g., disallowed outbound to public internet)?
4) Timeline: target go/no-go decision window? You mentioned "end of November" on the call correct?

Next steps from our side:
- We'll produce two options: Hosted + autoscaling (lowest friction) and Dedicated capacity (predictable latency) with cost estimates and expected SLOs.
- Attach: preliminary pricing and SOC2 attestation for your security team.
- Schedule: propose a follow-up with security/procurement on Fri 10/22 or Mon 10/25 which works for you?

Attachments: Redwood-pricing-2027Q3.pdf, SOC2-Redwood-Attestation.pdf

Thanks looking forward to the details so we can size the Dedicated config and provide an SOW draft.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

---
Redwood Inference production-first LLM inference for engineering teams
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finova.com>

Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finova.com>, Finova Security Team <security@finova.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Oct 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Decision criteria follow-up: latency / cost / deployment / next steps

Hi Marissa

Thanks for the clear recap that matches my notes. Quick answers inline: 

1) Economic buyer: Priya is the procurement owner and will own contract sign-off up to $250k. Anything above that will require CFO review (we can loop in Mark).
2) Latency SLAs: P95 <= 150ms is a hard requirement for most API flows; P99 <= 300ms is a goal but we understand tradeoffs during peak bursts. If Dedicated guarantees P99 under load, that would be preferred.
3) Deployment constraints: For Private deployment we require no direct outbound traffic from the model hosts to the public internet. All model updates must go through an approved gateway.
4) Timeline: Correct decision window is end of November, procurement needs a pricing doc and preliminary SOW by Nov 8 so legal can start redlines.

Also attaching Finova's one-page procurement checklist. Priya will share the full questionnaire to security. Happy to do a call with security next week.

Alex
Director of Product, Finova
alex.turner@finova.com | (617) 555-0199

Team

Recap & internal asks after Finova responses:
- Confirmed: P95 <= 150ms is hard requirement; P99 <= 300ms aspirational but important. Size Dedicated cluster to meet P99 under 150 reqs/sec sustained with 1.5x headroom for bursts (they said peaks up to 150 reqs/sec).
- Procurement wants 12-month reserved pricing + optional burst credits (3 months). Please produce: (a) Dedicated pricing sheet + (b) Hosted autoscale comparison showing expected cost delta and latency tradeoffs.
- Security: Finova requires no outbound traffic from model hosts; Private deployment option needs to document gateway update flow. Security also asked whether audit logs and KMS-integrations are available. David, can you attach the audit log sample and KMS notes?
- SOW: Priya requested an SLA table and liability clause; Stephanie, can you prepare an SOW skeleton with proposed SLA credits (available uptime, credit tiers) targeting Nov 8 delivery?

Proposed internal owners & deadlines:
- Dedicated sizing & pricing: Monica draft by Tue 10/26 EOD
- Hosted vs Dedicated cost comparison: Marissa + Monica Tue 10/26 EOD
- Audit logs & KMS details: David Mon 10/25 EOD (attach to reply)
- SOW skeleton & SLA table: Stephanie Wed 10/27 EOD

I'll confirm the security/procurement meeting time once Finova selects Mon 10/25 or Tue 10/26.

Thanks appreciate quick turnaround so legal can start redlines.
